signal.interpretation: Higher values mean more restrictive Funding and are tested only as a contrarian equity research signal.

price_method: Same exact-ticker Yahoo monthly adjusted-close helper used by the existing GMLI transmission/usefulness runner.

positive_market_drift_controls.unconditional_benchmark: Report conditional means/medians relative to the same evaluation-window unconditional 12M forward return.
positive_market_drift_controls.tercile_spread: Report high-minus-low inverted-Funding 12M return spread; common positive equity drift cancels in the spread.
positive_market_drift_controls.known_drift_excess: For each signal month, subtract the expanding mean 12M forward return from earlier observations whose return end month is no later than the current signal month; require at least 36 completed prior observations.
positive_market_drift_controls.hac: Newey-West/HAC regression with maxlags=12 because 12M forward returns overlap.

research_robustness_gate_per_asset.full_sample_raw: Pearson > 0, Spearman > 0, HAC slope > 0 with p < 0.10.
research_robustness_gate_per_asset.terciles: High-minus-low mean and median 12M forward return spreads > 0.
research_robustness_gate_per_asset.drift_adjusted: Known-drift-excess Pearson > 0, Spearman > 0, and high-minus-low mean excess-return spread > 0.
research_robustness_gate_per_asset.episode_robustness: Pearson remains > 0 in all three fixed leave-one-episode-out tests.
research_robustness_gate_per_asset.subperiod_robustness: At least two of the three fixed subperiod Pearson correlations are > 0.

overall_gate: Both SPY and QQQ must pass the per-asset research robustness gate.
